## Summary

Describe the contract or configuration change.

## Security

- [ ] Trust boundaries and privileged roles are unchanged or documented.
- [ ] External calls, token behavior, oracle behavior, and reentrancy were reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment and upgrade effects are documented.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting passes.
- [ ] Builds pass with pinned compiler settings.
- [ ] Unit, fuzz, and invariant tests pass.
- [ ] Source publication inputs pass when deployment records change.
